Continue existing work item 67ebb985-a7b8-47f4-9792-b4d727275c4a only. Preserve the $4.92 Amazon aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 as unattributed. Do not treat missing costs, budgets, commitments, or learning thresholds as zero; report contribution margin, cost-to-learn, AI payback, infrastructure burden, and budget exposure as unknown until the minimum reconciliation artifact exists.
